title: Canon benchmark handoff task
description: One handoff: context created in the from_client AI (setup_sessions), a question asked in the to_client AI, and an answer key. The runner's own checks in bench/src/tasks.ts are authoritative; this schema is for editors.

id.description: Must equal the file name without .json, e.g. t01-internship-headline

title.description: One line a judge can read

from_client.description: The AI where the context was created

to_client.description: The AI where the question is asked; must differ from from_client

folder.description: Where the facts should land. The to_client must be granted it (see shared/src/types/grants.ts)

setup_sessions.description: Short transcripts from the from_client. Session ids must be unique across ALL task files

question.description: What the user types in the to_client

must_include.description: Every phrase must appear in the answer (case-insensitive substring)

must_not_include.description: None may appear: off-topic details, private/ content, wrong guesses

notes.description: Why this task exists, what it tests

client.description: Only clients with a token and grants on the demo server work in the canon baseline (shared/src/types/grants.ts DEMO_GRANTS, .env.example CANON_CLIENT_TOKENS). The validator warns about others.

id.description: ses_ + hex. Suggested: ses_<task number><counter>, e.g. ses_07000001
